study type: Experimental animal model (piglet model) with in vitro component
cohort: The participants were 9 male and 3 female piglets delivered by Cesarean section.
finding: The meconium aspiration syndrome (MAS) group had significantly higher fluid and vasopressor requirements, and higher BALF concentrations of propionic acid, which was associated with decreased pulmonary epithelial cell viability and an upregulated pro-inflammatory response.
